/-! Explicit coordinate permutations for the endpoint-path coefficient map.
The normalization reads existing coefficients; it does not divide, rescale,
fit, or impose the desired Jacobian as an assumption. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Rearrange p,(d,c),q into (p,q),(d,c). -/
def pathShuffle (n : ℕ) : PathPolyData n ≃ₗ[ℝ] (PathCoefficients n × (ℝ × ℝ)) where
  toFun z := ((z.1,z.2.2),z.2.1)
  invFun z := (z.1.1,(z.2,z.1.2))
  left_inv z := rfl
  right_inv z := rfl
  map_add' z w := rfl
  map_smul' a z := rfl

/-- A degree-one monic polynomial has just one non-leading coefficient. -/
def baseCoefficientEquiv : PathCoefficients 0 ≃ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun z := (z.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0
  invFun a := (cut 1 (C a),0)
  left_inv z := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 1).injective
      funext i
      have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      change ((cut 1 (C ((z.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0)) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = _
      rw [cut_coeff 1 _ (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 1)]
      simp
    · apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective
      funext i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
  right_inv a := by
    change ((cut 1 (C a) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = a
    rw [cut_coeff 1 (C a) (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 1)]
    simp
  map_add' z w := by simp
  map_smul' a z := by simp

/-- The order of all original coefficient coordinates, recursively permuted. -/
def pathCoefficientEquiv : (n : ℕ) → PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathRates n
  | 0 => baseCoefficientEquiv
  | n+1 => (parentCoefficientEquiv n).trans (pathShuffle n) |>.trans
      ((pathCoefficientEquiv n).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))

/-- From normalized child coefficients and (d,c) to the local polynomial data. -/
def pathTransitionEquiv (n : ℕ) : PathRates (n+1) ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathPolyData n :=
  (((pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm.prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))).trans
    (pathShuffle n).symm

lemma pathCoefficientEquiv_succ (n : ℕ) (p : PathCoefficients (n+1)) :
    pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) p = (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm (parentCoefficientEquiv n p) := rfl

/-- The actual one-child coefficient operation in the explicit common order. -/
def normalizedPathStep (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) : PathRates (n+1) :=
  pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) (pathStepCoefficients (pathTransitionEquiv n z))

lemma normalizedPathStep_conjugate (n : ℕ) : normalizedPathStep n =
    fun z => (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm
      (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) (pathTransitionEquiv n z)) := by
  funext z
  rw [normalizedPathStep, pathCoefficientEquiv_succ, parentCoefficient_step_eq]

/-- Smoothness follows from the actual polynomial root operation. -/
theorem differentiable_normalizedPathStep (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedPathStep n) := by
  rw [normalizedPathStep_conjugate]
  intro z
  exact (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp z
    ((hasFDerivAt_rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)
      (pathTransitionEquiv n z)).differentiableAt.comp z
        (pathTransitionEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)

theorem normalizedPathStep_jacobian (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPathStep n) z = (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * z.2.2^n := by
  rw [normalizedPathStep_conjugate]
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
    (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)) z
    (hasFDerivAt_rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)
      (pathTransitionEquiv n z)).differentiableAt
  change endJacobian (fun z => (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm
      (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) (pathTransitionEquiv n z))) z = _ at h
  rw [h, endJacobian_rootTransition, finrank_coeff]
  rfl

end HydrologyTree

noncomputable section

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def scalarCouplingFiber (a : ℝ) : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) + ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod
    (a • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)

lemma det_scalarCouplingFiber (a : ℝ) : LinearMap.det (scalarCouplingFiber a).toLinearMap = a := by
  let b := (Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Basis.singleton Unit ℝ)
  have he : LinearMap.toMatrix b b (scalarCouplingFiber a).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 1 0 (a • (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ)) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [b, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, scalarCouplingFiber]
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b, he, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
  simp

def scalarCoupling (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) : E × (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (z.1,(z.2.1+z.2.2,a z.1*z.2.2))

def scalarCouplingDerivative (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (E × (ℝ × ℝ)) →L[ℝ] (E × (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) ((0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod (z.2.2 • a))
    (scalarCouplingFiber (a z.1))

theorem hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    HasFDerivAt (scalarCoupling a) (scalarCouplingDerivative a z) z := by
  let P : (E × (ℝ × ℝ)) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E _
  let L := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × ℝ))
  let F := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × ℝ))
  have hl := (L.hasFDerivAt (x := z)).add F.hasFDerivAt
  have hc := (a.hasFDerivAt.comp z P.hasFDerivAt).mul F.hasFDerivAt
  apply (P.hasFDerivAt.prodMk (hl.prodMk hc)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change h.2.1 + h.2.2 = 0 + (h.2.1+h.2.2)
      simp
    · change a z.1 * h.2.2 + z.2.2 * a h.1 = z.2.2 * a h.1 + a z.1 * h.2.2
      ring

theorem scalarCoupling_jacobian [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) : endJacobian (scalarCoupling a) z = a z.1 := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling a z), scalarCouplingDerivative,
    endDet_lowerBlock, det_scalarCouplingFiber]
  simp

end HydrologyTree

characteristic/cofactor coefficient map. Every rate value, including zero,
is allowed; all coordinate changes are explicit linear permutations. -/

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The actual physical coefficient map, merely put in a common coordinate order. -/
def normalizedPhysicalPath (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) : PathRates n :=
  pathCoefficientEquiv n (pathCoefficientMap n (pathRateEquiv n z))

lemma normalizedPhysicalPath_zero : normalizedPhysicalPath 0 = id := by
  funext a
  letI : Subsingleton (Fin (0+1)) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (Fin 1))
  change ((cut 1 (physicalCharacteristic (pathTree 0) (singletonRateEquiv a)) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = a
  rw [cut_coeff 1 _ (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 1)]
  rw [physicalCharacteristic, Matrix.charpoly,
    Matrix.det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin (0+1))]
  simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq, compartmentMatrix, singletonRateEquiv]

@[simp] lemma pathTransitionEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    pathTransitionEquiv n z =
      (((pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm z.1).1, (z.2,((pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm z.1).2)) := rfl

/-- The genuine physical recursion factors through the proved local maps. -/
theorem normalizedPhysicalPath_succ (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    normalizedPhysicalPath (n+1) z = normalizedPathStep n
      (keepFunction (normalizedPhysicalPath n) (scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z)) := by
  unfold normalizedPhysicalPath
  rw [pathRateEquiv_succ, pathCoefficientMap_recursion]
  unfold normalizedPathStep keepFunction scalarCoupling
  rw [pathTransitionEquiv_apply]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, pathLeak_apply]

lemma normalizedPhysicalPath_succ_fun (n : ℕ) :
    normalizedPhysicalPath (n+1) = normalizedPathStep n ∘
      (keepFunction (F := ℝ × ℝ) (normalizedPhysicalPath n) ∘ scalarCoupling (pathLeak n)) := by
  funext z
  exact normalizedPhysicalPath_succ n z

/-- Differentiability of the actual full coefficient map is proved by size induction. -/
theorem differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedPhysicalPath n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_zero]; exact differentiable_id
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_succ_fun]
    intro z
    have hc := (hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z).differentiableAt
    have hk := (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction (scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z) (ih z.1)).differentiableAt
    exact (differentiable_normalizedPathStep n _).comp z (hk.comp z hc)

/-- Exact one-step Jacobian recurrence, without inversion of any parameter. -/
theorem normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian_succ (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath (n+1)) z =

/-! Endpoint-catenary Jacobian for every finite size, evaluated on the actual
physical characteristic/root-cofactor coefficient map and original rate arrays.
The displayed bases only permute the explicitly defined scalar coordinates. -/
open Module Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

@[reducible] def PathCoordinateIndex : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => Unit
  | n+1 => PathCoordinateIndex n ⊕ (Unit ⊕ Unit)

instance pathCoordinateFintype : (n : ℕ) → Fintype (PathCoordinateIndex n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (Fintype Unit)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathCoordinateFintype n
    exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype (PathCoordinateIndex n ⊕ (Unit ⊕ Unit)))

instance pathCoordinateDecidableEq (n : ℕ) : DecidableEq (PathCoordinateIndex n) := Classical.decEq _

/-- Every basis vector is a single unscaled physical rate coordinate. -/
def pathRateBasis : (n : ℕ) → Basis (PathCoordinateIndex n) ℝ (PathRates n)
  | 0 => Basis.singleton Unit ℝ
  | n+1 => (pathRateBasis n).prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Basis.singleton Unit ℝ))

def catenaryInputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (PathCoordinateIndex n) ℝ (TreeRates n) :=
  (pathRateBasis n).map (pathRateEquiv n)

def catenaryOutputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (PathCoordinateIndex n) ℝ (PathCoefficients n) :=
  (pathRateBasis n).map (pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm

/-- The determinant of fderiv of the actual original path coefficient map. -/
def catenaryJacobian (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryInputBasis n) (catenaryOutputBasis n)
    (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x).toLinearMap).det

lemma toMatrix_coordinate_transport {E X Y I : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℝ X]
    [AddCommGroup Y] [Module ℝ Y] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (b : Basis I ℝ E) (ein : E ≃ₗ[ℝ] X) (eout : Y ≃ₗ[ℝ] E) (L : X →ₗ[ℝ] Y) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (b.map ein) (b.map eout.symm) L =
      LinearMap.toMatrix b b (eout.toLinearMap.comp (L.comp ein.toLinearMap)) := by
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Basis.map_repr]

/-- Exact transport from the common-coordinate induction to the actual derivative. -/
theorem normalizedPathJacobian_eq_catenary (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z = catenaryJacobian n (pathRateEquiv n z) := by
  have hc := (differentiable_pathCoefficientMap n (pathRateEquiv n z)).hasFDerivAt
  have h := (pathCoefficientEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (hc.comp z (pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt)
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z =
      (pathCoefficientEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        ((fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) (pathRateEquiv n z)).comp
          (pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap) := h.fderiv
  rw [endJacobian, hd, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (pathRateBasis n),
    catenaryJacobian, catenaryInputBasis, catenaryOutputBasis, toMatrix_coordinate_transport]
  rfl

/-- Full all-size endpoint-catenary formula, including every zero-rate boundary.
For n edges the inward exponents are n,n-1,...,1 and the outward exponents
are n-1,n-2,...,0. The root leak is unrestricted and contributes no factor. -/
theorem catenaryJacobian_eq (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryJacobian n x = pathOrientation n *
      ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1) := by
  have h := normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm x)
  rw [normalizedPathJacobian_eq_catenary, pathWeight_eq_rate_monomial] at h
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, pathRateMonomial] using h

/-- Orientation-free form of the same exact identity. -/
theorem catenaryJacobian_sq (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryJacobian n x ^ 2 =
      (∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1)) ^ 2 := by
  rw [catenaryJacobian_eq, mul_pow, pathOrientation_sq, one_mul]

lemma pathOrientation_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : pathOrientation n ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hs := pathOrientation_sq n
  rw [h] at hs
  norm_num at hs

lemma pathRateMonomial_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    pathRateMonomial n x = 0 ↔
      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) := by
  rw [pathRateMonomial, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i,_,hi⟩
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hi with ha | hf
    · left
      refine ⟨i,?_⟩
      by_contra h
      exact (pow_ne_zero _ h) ha
    · right
      have hp : 0 < n-i.val-1 := by
        by_contra h
        have he : n-i.val-1 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
        rw [he, pow_zero] at hf
        exact one_ne_zero hf
      refine ⟨i, by omega, ?_⟩
      by_contra h
      exact (pow_ne_zero _ h) hf
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨i,ha⟩ | ⟨i,hi,hf⟩
    · refine ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ i,?_⟩
      have hp : n-i.val ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt i.isLt)
      simp [ha, hp]
    · refine ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ i,?_⟩
      have hp : n-i.val-1 ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp [hf, hp]

/-- Exact real singular set of the original unreduced coefficient map. -/
theorem catenaryJacobian_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryJacobian n x = 0 ↔
      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) := by
  rw [catenaryJacobian_eq, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [pathOrientation_ne_zero, false_or]
  exact pathRateMonomial_zero_iff n x

/-- Inward rates and nonterminal outward rates are exactly the required nonzeros.
The last outward rate and root leak may vanish without Jacobian singularity. -/
theorem catenaryJacobian_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0)
    (hf : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n → x.2 i ≠ 0) : catenaryJacobian n x ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  rcases (catenaryJacobian_zero_iff n x).mp hz with (⟨i,hi⟩ | ⟨i,hi,h0⟩)
  · exact ha i hi
  · exact hf i hi h0

/-! Transport to the usual ascending coefficient and physical-array bases.
The conversion factor is explicit, nonzero and depends only on the number of
compartments, never on the rates. No change of the physical coefficient map. -/
open Module Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev CatenaryArrayIndex (n : ℕ) := Fin (n+1) ⊕ Fin n

def catenaryArrayInputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (CatenaryArrayIndex n) ℝ (TreeRates n) :=
  (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n))

def catenaryArrayOutputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (CatenaryArrayIndex n) ℝ (PathCoefficients n) :=
  (degreeLT.basis ℝ (n+1)).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)

/-- Usual physical rate arrays and ascending non-leading P/F coefficients. -/
def catenaryCanonicalJacobian (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
    (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x).toLinearMap).det

/-- Explicit linear coefficient permutation, independent of all rate parameters. -/
def catenaryCoordinateReturn (n : ℕ) : PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  (pathCoefficientEquiv n).trans (pathRateEquiv n)

def catenaryCoordinateDet (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
    (catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toLinearMap).det

lemma catenaryCoordinateDet_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : catenaryCoordinateDet n ≠ 0 := by
  let e := catenaryCoordinateReturn n
  have he : e.toLinearMap.comp e.symm.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact e.apply_symm_apply x
  have hm := congrArg
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)) he
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
    (catenaryArrayInputBasis n), LinearMap.toMatrix_id] at hm
  have hd := congrArg Matrix.det hm
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_one] at hd
  intro hz
  change catenaryCoordinateDet n * _ = 1 at hd
  rw [hz, zero_mul] at hd
  exact zero_ne_one hd

    endJacobian (fun y => catenaryCoordinateReturn n (pathCoefficientMap n y)) x =
      catenaryCoordinateDet n * catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x := by
  have h := (catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x
    (differentiable_pathCoefficientMap n x).hasFDerivAt
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => catenaryCoordinateReturn n (pathCoefficientMap n y)) x =
      (catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x) := h.fderiv
  rw [endJacobian, hd, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ ((catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toLinearMap.comp
    (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x).toLinearMap)).det = _
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
    (catenaryArrayInputBasis n), Matrix.det_mul]
  rfl

    catenaryCoordinateDet n * catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x =
      pathOrientation n * pathRateMonomial n x := by
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate (pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv
    (normalizedPhysicalPath n) x
    (differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm x))
  have he : (fun y => (pathRateEquiv n) (normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm y))) =
      (fun y => catenaryCoordinateReturn n (pathCoefficientMap n y)) := by
    funext y
    simp [normalizedPhysicalPath, catenaryCoordinateReturn]
  change endJacobian (fun y => (pathRateEquiv n) (normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm y))) x = _ at h
  rw [he, array_normalized_jacobian, normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian,
    pathWeight_eq_rate_monomial] at h
  have hh : (pathRateEquiv n) ((pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.symm x) = x :=
    (pathRateEquiv n).apply_symm_apply x
  rwa [hh] at h

lemma catenaryCanonicalFactor_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : catenaryCanonicalFactor n ≠ 0 :=

size-dependent constant. There are no additional parameter-dependent factors. -/

    catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x = catenaryCanonicalFactor n *
      ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1) := by

    simpa only [mul_comm] using h
  rw [he, catenaryCanonicalFactor, pathRateMonomial]

      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) := by
  rw [catenaryCanonicalJacobian_eq, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [catenaryCanonicalFactor_ne_zero, false_or]
  exact pathRateMonomial_zero_iff n x

/-! Unscaled coordinate transport: a direct finite bilinear-form proof that
all path coefficient and physical-array reorderings preserve coefficient dot
products. This closes the possible hidden size-dependent scaling of Jacobians. -/
open Polynomial Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def coefficientDot (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff n) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, (p : ℝ[X]).coeff i * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff i

def pathCoefficientDot (n : ℕ) (p q : PathCoefficients n) : ℝ :=
  coefficientDot (n+1) p.1 q.1 + coefficientDot n p.2 q.2

def physicalRateDot (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i : Fin (n+1), x.1 i * y.1 i) + ∑ i : Fin n, x.2 i * y.2 i

@[reducible] def nestedPathDot : (n : ℕ) → PathRates n → PathRates n → ℝ
  | 0, x, y => x*y
  | n+1, x, y => nestedPathDot n x.1 y.1 + x.2.1*y.2.1 + x.2.2*y.2.2

lemma coefficientDot_succ (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff (n+1)) :
    coefficientDot (n+1) p q = (p : ℝ[X]).coeff n * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff n +
      coefficientDot n (cut n (p : ℝ[X])) (cut n (q : ℝ[X])) := by
  simp only [coefficientDot, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc,
    Fin.val_last, cut_coeff]
  exact add_comm _ _

lemma coefficientDot_two (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff (n+2)) :
    coefficientDot (n+2) p q =
      (p : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1) * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1) +
      (p : ℝ[X]).coeff n * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff n +
      coefficientDot n (cut n (p : ℝ[X])) (cut n (q : ℝ[X])) := by
  rw [coefficientDot_succ (n+1), coefficientDot_succ n,
    cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩,
    cut_coeff (n+1) (q : ℝ[X]) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩,
    cut_cut (Nat.le_succ n), cut_cut (Nat.le_succ n)]
  ring

lemma prependRateEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n) (a b c d : ℝ) :
    physicalRateDot (n+1) (prependRateEquiv n (x,(a,b)))
      (prependRateEquiv n (y,(c,d))) = physicalRateDot n x y + a*c + b*d := by
  simp only [physicalRateDot, prependRateEquiv_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
  ring

/-- The recursive rate equivalence is unscaled in the original physical arrays. -/
theorem pathRateEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (x y : PathRates n) :
    physicalRateDot n (pathRateEquiv n x) (pathRateEquiv n y) = nestedPathDot n x y := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [pathRateEquiv, singletonRateEquiv, physicalRateDot, nestedPathDot]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathRateEquiv_succ, pathRateEquiv_succ, prependRateEquiv_dot, ih]

lemma pathCoefficientEquiv_explicit_succ (n : ℕ) (p : PathCoefficients (n+1)) :
    pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) p =
      (pathCoefficientEquiv n (p.2,cut n (p.1 : ℝ[X])),
        ((p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1),(p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff n)) := by
  change (pathCoefficientEquiv n (p.2, (topTwoEquiv n p.1).2),
    (topTwoEquiv n p.1).1) = _
  rw [topTwoEquiv_apply]

/-- The output-coordinate equivalence only reorders existing coefficients. -/
theorem pathCoefficientEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    nestedPathDot n (pathCoefficientEquiv n p) (pathCoefficientEquiv n q) =
      pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change (p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 * (q.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = _
    simp [pathCoefficientDot, coefficientDot, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathCoefficientEquiv_explicit_succ, pathCoefficientEquiv_explicit_succ]
    change nestedPathDot n (pathCoefficientEquiv n _) (pathCoefficientEquiv n _) + _ + _ = _
    rw [ih]
    unfold pathCoefficientDot
    rw [coefficientDot_two]
    ring

/-- Dot product in an arbitrary finite basis. -/
def basisDot {E I : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Fintype I]
    (b : Basis I ℝ E) (x y : E) : ℝ := ∑ i, b.repr x i * b.repr y i

/-- A bilinear-form-preserving coefficient map has determinant square one. -/
theorem det_sq_of_basisDot_preserved {E F I : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F]
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (bE : Basis I ℝ E) (bF : Basis I ℝ F)
    (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hL : ∀ x y, basisDot bF (L x) (L y) = basisDot bE x y) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L).det ^ 2 = 1 := by
  let M := LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L
  have hM : M.transpose * M = 1 := by
    ext i j
    change (∑ k : I, M k i * M k j) = (1 : Matrix I I ℝ) i j
    simp only [M, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    change basisDot bF (L (bE i)) (L (bE j)) = _
    rw [hL]
    simp [basisDot, Matrix.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]
  have hd := congrArg Matrix.det hM
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at hd
  simpa only [pow_two] using hd

end HydrologyTree

of the outward rates and the root leak. -/
theorem physicalRootCofactor_eval_zero_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)

  rw [physicalRootCofactor_eval_zero]
  exact Finset.prod_pos (fun e _ => ha e)

/-- The root leak is an actual coefficient invariant on the nonzero-inward domain. -/

    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) :
    x.1 0 = (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval 0 / (physicalRootCofactor t x).eval 0 := by
  rw [physicalCharacteristic_eval_zero_leak]
  exact (mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (physicalRootCofactor_eval_zero_ne_zero t x ha)).symm

import HydrologyTree.PathPolynomial
import HydrologyTree.PhysicalConstants

/-! Algebraic recovery from actual characteristic/cofactor coefficients.
No local-inverse theorem or unproved generic identifiability premise is used. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Equality of the retained coefficients is exactly equality of both actual
unreduced monic polynomials. -/
theorem physicalCoefficientMap_eq_iff {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n) :
    physicalCoefficientMap t x = physicalCoefficientMap t y ↔
      physicalCharacteristic t x = physicalCharacteristic t y ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x = physicalRootCofactor t y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · have hp := congrArg (fun z : Coeff (n+1) × Coeff n => (monicPoly z.1 : ℝ[X])) h
      rwa [physicalCoefficientMap_first_reconstruct, physicalCoefficientMap_first_reconstruct] at hp
    · have hf := congrArg (fun z : Coeff (n+1) × Coeff n => (monicPoly z.2 : ℝ[X])) h
      rwa [physicalCoefficientMap_second_reconstruct, physicalCoefficientMap_second_reconstruct] at hf
  · rintro ⟨hp,hf⟩
    simp only [physicalCoefficientMap, hp, hf]

/-- Nonzero inward rates can be detected from an actual cofactor coefficient. -/
theorem physical_inward_nonzero_iff {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) ↔ (physicalRootCofactor t x).eval 0 ≠ 0 := by
  rw [physicalRootCofactor_eval_zero, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  simp

/-- Any model sharing complete coefficient data with a nonzero-inward model
has the same root leak, even when the alternative model was not assumed regular. -/
theorem physical_root_leak_identified {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hx : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0)
    (h : physicalCoefficientMap t x = physicalCoefficientMap t y) : x.1 0 = y.1 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hp,hf⟩ := (physicalCoefficientMap_eq_iff t x y).mp h
  have hy : ∀ e : Fin n, y.1 e.succ ≠ 0 := by
    apply (physical_inward_nonzero_iff t y).mpr
    rw [← hf]
    exact (physical_inward_nonzero_iff t x).mp hx
  rw [physical_root_leak_eq_ratio t x hx, physical_root_leak_eq_ratio t y hy, hp, hf]

section Transition
variable {P E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

/-- Complete triangular recovery, including the dimension-zero numerator case. -/
theorem rootTransition_fiber_unique (α β : P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L K : P →L[ℝ] E)
    (z w : RootTransitionSpace P E)
    (hz : z.2.1.2 ≠ 0 ∨ Subsingleton E)
    (h : rootTransition α β L K z = rootTransition α β L K w) : z = w := by
  have hp := congrArg (fun u : RootTransitionSpace P E => u.1) h
  change z.1 = w.1 at hp
  have hd0 := congrArg (fun u : RootTransitionSpace P E => u.2.1.1) h
  change z.2.1.1 + α z.1 = w.2.1.1 + α w.1 at hd0
  rw [hp] at hd0
  have hd : z.2.1.1 = w.2.1.1 := add_right_cancel hd0
  have hc0 := congrArg (fun u : RootTransitionSpace P E => u.2.1.2) h
  change β z.1 + z.2.1.1 * α z.1 - z.2.1.2 =
    β w.1 + w.2.1.1 * α w.1 - w.2.1.2 at hc0
  rw [hp,hd] at hc0
  have hc : z.2.1.2 = w.2.1.2 := sub_right_inj.mp hc0
  have hq : z.2.2 = w.2.2 := by
    rcases hz with hz | hs
    · have hw : w.2.1.2 ≠ 0 := by rwa [← hc]
      have hq0 := congrArg (fun u : RootTransitionSpace P E => u.2.2) h
      change L z.1 + z.2.1.1 • K z.1 - z.2.1.2 • z.2.2 =
        L w.1 + w.2.1.1 • K w.1 - w.2.1.2 • w.2.2 at hq0
      rw [hp,hd,hc] at hq0
      have hq1 := sub_right_inj.mp hq0
      have hq2 := congrArg (fun v : E => (w.2.1.2)⁻¹ • v) hq1
      simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hw, one_smul] using hq2
    · exact hs.elim _ _
  exact Prod.ext hp (Prod.ext (Prod.ext hd hc) hq)

end Transition

/-- Recovery from the actual one-child polynomial coefficient operation.
A zero scalar is permitted precisely when the lower numerator space is trivial. -/
theorem pathStepCoefficients_fiber_unique {n : ℕ} (z w : PathPolyData n)
    (hz : z.2.1.2 ≠ 0 ∨ n = 0) (h : pathStepCoefficients z = pathStepCoefficients w) : z = w := by
  have hh := congrArg (parentCoefficientEquiv n) h
  rw [parentCoefficient_step_eq, parentCoefficient_step_eq] at hh
  apply rootTransition_fiber_unique _ _ _ _ z w _ hh
  rcases hz with hz | hn
  · exact Or.inl hz
  · subst n
    right
    refine ⟨fun p q => ?_⟩
    apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective
    funext i
    exact Fin.elim0 i

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.CatenaryOrientation
import HydrologyTree.RootRecovery

/-! Global uniqueness of the entire real coefficient fiber at every nonsingular
endpoint-path model. The second model is arbitrary, not assumed regular or positive.
This is stronger than a local inverse-function conclusion, but does not assert
existence of a realization for an arbitrary prescribed response. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def PathRegularRates (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n → x.2 i ≠ 0)

/-- The exact algebraic regularity conditions imply uniqueness of the entire
real fiber of the original unreduced physical coefficient map. -/
theorem catenary_coefficient_fiber_unique (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hx : PathRegularRates n x) (hxy : pathCoefficientMap n x = pathCoefficientMap n y) : x = y := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have hleak := physical_root_leak_identified (pathTree 0) x y hx.1 hxy
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i
      have hi : i = 0 := Fin.ext (by omega)
      subst i
      exact hleak
    · funext i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨u,ell,f⟩,rfl⟩ := (prependRateEquiv n).surjective x
    obtain ⟨⟨v,ell',g⟩,rfl⟩ := (prependRateEquiv n).surjective y
    have hell : ell = ell' := physical_root_leak_identified (pathTree (n+1))
      (prependRateEquiv n (u,(ell,f))) (prependRateEquiv n (v,(ell',g))) hx.1 hxy
    have hs : u.1 0 * f ≠ 0 ∨ n = 0 := by
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · exact Or.inr hn
      · left
        apply mul_ne_zero
        · exact hx.1 0
        · exact hx.2 0 (by simp only [Fin.val_zero]; omega)
    have hstep := hxy
    rw [pathCoefficientMap_recursion, pathCoefficientMap_recursion] at hstep
    have hdata := pathStepCoefficients_fiber_unique
      ((pathCoefficientMap n u).1,((ell+f,u.1 0*f),(pathCoefficientMap n u).2))
      ((pathCoefficientMap n v).1,((ell'+g,v.1 0*g),(pathCoefficientMap n v).2)) hs hstep
    have hchild : pathCoefficientMap n u = pathCoefficientMap n v := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact congrArg (fun z : PathPolyData n => z.1) hdata
      · exact congrArg (fun z : PathPolyData n => z.2.2) hdata
    have hu : PathRegularRates n u := by
      constructor
      · intro i
        exact hx.1 i.succ
      · intro i hi
        exact hx.2 i.succ (by simp only [Fin.val_succ]; omega)
    have huv : u = v := ih u v hu hchild
    have hd : ell+f = ell'+g := congrArg (fun z : PathPolyData n => z.2.1.1) hdata
    have hfg : f = g := by linarith
    rw [huv,hell,hfg]

/-- No regularity assumption is placed on the alternative real model. -/
theorem catenary_global_fiber_at_regular_point (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x ≠ 0) :
    ∀ y : TreeRates n, pathCoefficientMap n y = pathCoefficientMap n x → y = x := by
  have hr : PathRegularRates n x := by
    constructor
    · intro i hi
      exact hx ((catenary_standard_singular_locus n x).mpr (Or.inl ⟨i,hi⟩))
    · intro i hi h0
      exact hx ((catenary_standard_singular_locus n x).mpr (Or.inr ⟨i,hi,h0⟩))
  intro y hy
  exact (catenary_coefficient_fiber_unique n x y hr hy.symm).symm

/-- Every strictly positive internal-rate endpoint path has a singleton real
coefficient fiber, not only a singleton fiber among positive competitors. -/
theorem catenary_positive_global_identification (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 < x.1 i.succ) (hf : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 < x.2 i) :
    ∀ y : TreeRates n, pathCoefficientMap n y = pathCoefficientMap n x → y = x := by
  have hr : PathRegularRates n x := ⟨fun i => ne_of_gt (ha i),fun i _ => ne_of_gt (hf i)⟩
  intro y hy
  exact (catenary_coefficient_fiber_unique n x y hr hy.symm).symm

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.CatenaryGlobal
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Div

/-! Minimality and true rational-response identification for endpoint paths.
Nonzero outward rates are necessary here, unlike the weaker condition for an
unreduced coefficient Jacobian. No ODE controllability theorem is claimed. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma isCoprime_root_step (P F : ℝ[X]) (d k : ℝ)
    (hk : k ≠ 0) (h : IsCoprime P F) : IsCoprime ((X+C d)*P-C k*F) P := by
  obtain ⟨u,v,h⟩ := h
  refine ⟨-C k⁻¹*v, u+C k⁻¹*v*(X+C d), ?_⟩
  calc
    (-C k⁻¹*v)*((X+C d)*P-C k*F) + (u+C k⁻¹*v*(X+C d))*P
        = u*P + (C k⁻¹*C k)*v*F := by ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hk, map_one, one_mul]; exact h

/-- Actual characteristic and cofactor polynomials have no cancellations when
all internal rates are nonzero, with the root leak arbitrary. -/
theorem catenary_characteristic_cofactor_coprime (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ i : Fin n, x.2 i ≠ 0) :
    IsCoprime (physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) x) (physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) x) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have hF : physicalRootCofactor (pathTree 0) x = 1 := by
      simp [physicalRootCofactor]
    rw [hF]
    exact isCoprime_one_right
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨u,ell,f⟩,rfl⟩ := (prependRateEquiv n).surjective x
    rw [path_characteristic_recursion, path_cofactor_recursion]
    apply isCoprime_root_step _ _ _ _ (mul_ne_zero (ha 0) (hf 0))
    exact ih u (fun i => ha i.succ) (fun i => hf i.succ)

/-- If one rational response is represented by coprime polynomials of full
prescribed degree, any other monic representation of that same degree agrees. -/
theorem full_degree_fraction_unique (P F Q G : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P.Monic) (hQ : Q.Monic) (hdeg : Q.natDegree = P.natDegree)
    (hcop : IsCoprime P F) (h : F*Q = G*P) : P = Q ∧ F = G := by
  have hdvd : P ∣ Q := hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (by rw [h]; exact dvd_mul_left P G)
  have he : P = Q := (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hP hQ hdvd hdeg.le).symm
  constructor
  · exact he
  · rw [← he] at h
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hP.ne_zero h

/-- Input/output transfer equality, expressed as a polynomial rational-function
identity, implies equality of all coefficients for a noncancelling reference path.
The alternative model's internal rates are arbitrary. -/
theorem catenary_response_identifies_coefficients (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ i : Fin n, x.2 i ≠ 0)
    (h : physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) x * physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) y =
      physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) y * physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) x) :
    pathCoefficientMap n x = pathCoefficientMap n y := by
  apply (physicalCoefficientMap_eq_iff (pathTree n) x y).mpr
  apply full_degree_fraction_unique _ _ _ _
    (physicalCharacteristic_monic _ _) (physicalCharacteristic_monic _ _) _
    (catenary_characteristic_cofactor_coprime n x ha hf) h
  rw [physicalCharacteristic_natDegree, physicalCharacteristic_natDegree]

/-- Full real-fiber identification from the actual rational response, for a path
with nonzero internal rates; the competitor is not assumed positive or minimal. -/
theorem catenary_global_transfer_identification (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ i : Fin n, x.2 i ≠ 0)
    (h : physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) x * physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) y =
      physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) y * physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) x) : x = y := by
  exact catenary_coefficient_fiber_unique n x y ⟨ha,fun i _ => hf i⟩
    (catenary_response_identifies_coefficients n x y ha hf h)

/-- Equality on the common nonpole domain of the ACTUAL root resolvent entries
implies the rational polynomial identity. Totalized values at poles are not used. -/
theorem physical_response_eq_implies_cross_identity {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (x y : TreeRates n)
    (h : ∀ s : ℝ, (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s ≠ 0 →
      (physicalCharacteristic t y).eval s ≠ 0 →
      physicalRootResponse t x s = physicalRootResponse t y s) :
    physicalRootCofactor t x * physicalCharacteristic t y =
      physicalRootCofactor t y * physicalCharacteristic t x := by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (infinite_nonroots
    (physicalCharacteristic t x * physicalCharacteristic t y)
    (mul_ne_zero (physicalCharacteristic_monic t x).ne_zero
      (physicalCharacteristic_monic t y).ne_zero)).mono
  intro s hs
  have hh : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s * (physicalCharacteristic t y).eval s ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_mul] using hs
  have hx := left_ne_zero_of_mul hh
  have hy := right_ne_zero_of_mul hh
  have he := h s hx hy
  rw [physicalRootResponse_eq, physicalRootResponse_eq] at he
  have hc := (div_eq_div_iff hx hy).mp he
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Polynomial.eval_mul] using hc

/-- Exact equality of actual root resolvents determines every path rate, provided
only the reference path has nonzero internal edges. No alternate-model hypotheses. -/
theorem catenary_global_resolvent_identification (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ i : Fin n, x.2 i ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ s : ℝ, (physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) x).eval s ≠ 0 →
      (physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) y).eval s ≠ 0 →
      physicalRootResponse (pathTree n) x s = physicalRootResponse (pathTree n) y s) : x = y := by
  exact catenary_global_transfer_identification n x y ha hf
    (physical_response_eq_implies_cross_identity (pathTree n) x y h)

end HydrologyTree
